pergunta: What kind of writings does Joanna do?

focused_selection.text:
Session date: 3:56 pm on 4 November, 2022
[D26:4] Nate: Way to go, Joanna! Putting yourself out there is really brave and winning recognition for your hard work feels great. It's just like when I win a video game tournament - it feels awesome! I'm so proud of you and so glad you're feeling hopeful and inspired.
[D26:5] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Your support and encouragement mean a lot. Writing isn't always easy but moments like these make me appreciate it. I'm so thankful for all the opportunities. Last week, I found these old notebooks with my early writings - it was cool to see how far I've come.
[D26:6] Nate: That's cool! You must love seeing how you've grown as an artist. Is there a favorite piece from your early writings that stands out to you?
[D26:7] Joanna: Yup, I still remember this story from when I was 10. It was about a brave little turtle who was scared but explored the world anyway. Maybe even back then, I was inspired by stories about finding courage and taking risks. It's still a part of my writing today.
[...]
Session date: 8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022
[D27:3] Nate: Thanks, Joanna! I've been having a blast and preparing for other tournaments, so I've been real busy - but I'm loving it!
[D27:4] Joanna: Sounds like you're really loving life right now! It's great when you find something that suits you. Being busy can be tiring but it's so rewarding in the end. Keep it up!
[D27:5] Nate: Thanks, Joanna! I'm really grateful to have a job I enjoy every day. So anyways, anything new going on in your life?
[D27:6] Joanna: I am writing another movie script! It's a love story with lots of challenges. I've put lots of hard work into it and I'm hoping to get it on the big screen.
[D27:7] Nate: Woah Joanna, that's incredible! I remember when you started working on these sorta things. It's crazy to see how far you've gotten! You've really got a thing for writing, huh? Where'd you get the idea for it?
[D27:8] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Writing has always been a passion of mine. I got the idea for this script from a dream. How have your turtles been? I haven't seen pictures of them in a while!
[D27:9] Nate: Great actually! These little guys sure bring joy to my life! Watching them is so calming and fascinating. I've really grown fond of them. So, what about you, Joanna? What brings you happiness?
[D27:10] Joanna: Creating stories and watching them come alive gives me happiness and fulfillment. Writing has been such a blessing for me.

Session date: 2:01 pm on 23 January, 2022
[D2:17] Joanna: Oh? That sounds sweet! Is it a weird relationship with them being competitors and all?
[D2:18] Nate: Oh, kind of. Some people are more competitive then others, so I tend to just stick around the more chill people here.
[D2:19] Joanna: That makes sense! Are you gonna cheer them on even if you lose?

Session date: 9:27 am on 7 February, 2022
[D3:1] Joanna: Hey Nate, long time no see! The screenplay I sent in to the film festival has been on my mind all day everyday. I keep bouncing between crazy emotions like relief, excitement and worry! Fingers crossed a producer or director falls in love with it and it ends up on the big screen - that would be awesome!
[D3:2] Nate: Hey Joanna! It is a big deal! I'm sure its been a wild ride. Sending some positive vibes and hoping someone likes it enough to get it on the big screen - that would be awesome!
[D3:3] Joanna: Thanks Nate, your support really means a lot. I put a lot of effort into it and I'm crossing my fingers. What about you? Anything new and exciting happening in your life?
[D3:4] Nate: Thanks, Joanna. Not much has changed for me, but I just discovered that I can make coconut milk icecream and gave it a try. It was actually pretty good, so I'm proud of myself.
[D3:5] Joanna: Looks delish! Glad you tried something new and it went well. What did you think of it?
[D3:6] Nate: Super good! It was rich and creamy - might be my new favorite snack!
[D3:7] Joanna: Great! I love when you try something new and it actually works out. Will you give it another go?
[D3:8] Nate: Yep, it could be fun! I'm looking forward to trying out different flavors and toppings.
[D3:9] Joanna: Yum! Sounds great. Got any favorite flavors for dairy-free desserts?

Session date: 8:16 pm on 25 October, 2022
[D25:7] Nate: Wow Joanna, those drawings are really incredible! What inspired you to create them?
[D25:8] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! They're visuals of the characters to help bring them alive in my head so I can write better.
[D25:9] Nate: That's a cool way to gain insight into your characters. Where did you get your ideas for them?
[D25:10] Joanna: I got ideas from everywhere: people I know, stuff I saw, even what I imagined. It's cool to see how an idea takes shape into a person with their own wants, worries, and wishes.
[D25:11] Nate: Wow Joanna, that's so cool! It's amazing how our imaginations can bring ideas to life. Can you tell me more about the character on the left in the photo?
[D25:12] Joanna: Nope! You'll just have to watch the movie and find out for yourself!
[D25:13] Nate: You got it. I was already planning on watching it, but talking to you about it makes me want to watch it even more!
[D25:14] Joanna: Awesome! Well enough about me, what have you been up to?
[D25:15] Nate: I was bored today, so I just took my turtles out for a walk.
[D25:16] Joanna: Sound fun! Did they have a good time?
[D25:17] Nate: Of course! They look tired from all the walking, so they're relaxing in the tank right now.
[D25:18] Joanna: Aww, they're so cute! What do they eat?

Session date: 2:12 pm on 5 June, 2022
[D15:2] Nate: Congrats, Joanna! Seeing your hard work pay off like that must've felt amazing. I bet it was scary too, but awesome! You're so inspiring. By the way, last time we saw eachother, I noticed a spiderman pin on your purse. Is Spider-Man your favorite superhero, or do you have another fave?
[D15:3] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! It was a real roller coaster, but seeing the hard work pay off was amazing. Spider-Man has always been a favorite of mine - I mean, who doesn't love Peter Parker's struggles between being a hero and being a person? But I'm kind of a sucker for any superhero - everyone has their own rad story and powers. Do you have a favorite superhero?
[D15:4] Nate: That's great, Joanna! Iron Man is my top pick. I love his tech and that sarcastic humor. Seeing these figures just makes me feel invincible!
[...]
Session date: 10:55 am on 24 June, 2022
[D16:14] Nate: Then I have no doubt they'll love the icecream!
[D16:15] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Your support is greatly appreciated. I'll make sure to keep you updated.
[D16:16] Nate: Can't wait to hear about it. Have a great day! Take care.
Session date: 2:34 pm on 10 July, 2022
[D17:1] Nate: Hey Joanna, check this out! I won my fourth video game tournament on Friday! It was awesome competing and showing off my skills - and the victory was indescribable. I'm really proud that I can make money doing what I love. This one was online!
[D17:2] Joanna: Congrats, Nate! That's awesome! So proud of you. Your hard work really paid off - keep it up! BTW, I took a road trip for research for my next movie while you were winning. Much-needed break and a chance to explore new places and get inspired.
[D17:3] Nate: Thanks, Joanna! Your support means a lot to me. That road trip sounds great! Where did you go? Did you discover any interesting places?
[D17:4] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Appreciate your kind words. I went to Woodhaven, a small town in the Midwest. Got to see some lovely scenery and historic buildings. Checked out the library there, it had a cool old book collection!
[D17:5] Nate: That place looks interesting! Did you find any cool books there?
[D17:6] Joanna: I stumbled upon this super cool book from the 1900s with stories and sketches - so awesome to read about the town and the people living there!

[D20:5] Nate: What else are you making? It's always satisfying to see the kind of things you do when your in one of those moods!

Session date: 1:43 pm on 14 September, 2022
[D21:8] Nate: Yeah sure! Would love to share it. Let's spread the joy of dairy-free options! Let me know when you make it!
[D21:9] Joanna: Cool, Nate! Gonna give it a go. Dairy-free is a must for me, especially for desserts. Last Friday, I made a deeeelish dessert with almond milk - it was good! Got any favs when it comes to dairy-free desserts?
[D21:10] Nate: Coconut milk ice cream is one of my favorites as you might be able to tell, but I also love a dairy-free chocolate mousse. It's super creamy and tastes like the real thing. What's been your favorite dairy-free sweet treat so far?
[D21:11] Joanna: Hey Nate, my favorite dairy-free treat is this amazing chocolate raspberry tart. It has an almond flour crust, chocolate ganache, and fresh raspberries - it's delicious!
[D21:12] Nate: That looks amazing, Joanna! I need to try baking that. What other treats do you like making?
[D21:13] Joanna: Hey Nate, I love making this dairy-free chocolate cake with raspberries. It's so moist and delicious - perfect sweetness level.
[D21:14] Nate: That cake looks amazing, Joanna! How did you make it?
[D21:15] Joanna: I make it with almond flour, coconut oil, chocolate and raspberries. It's my favorite for birthdays and special days.
[D21:16] Nate: Yum, Joanna! Gotta try that one. Any others you want to share?
